title: Simple Linear-Time Polygon Triangulation
exact_target: Find a deterministic linear-time triangulation algorithm for arbitrary simple polygons that is significantly simpler than Chazelle\textquotesingle s. The related question recorded with it asks for a simple linear-time algorithm computing a shortest path within a simple polygon without first using a more complicated triangulation algorithm.
